description: The pie chart presents a breakdown of two categories related to the paper’s context, showing how the total is divided between “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” It contains 2 slices: a large orange slice labeled “Reduction” with an internal label of 60.9s (69.92%), and a smaller blue slice labeled “Efficient deployment” with an internal label of 26.2s (30.08%). Percentage and time values are printed inside both slices, there is no separate legend, and the blue “Efficient deployment” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded/offset from the rest of the pie.
